evidence_items.finding: owner works six days per week and is booked three weeks in advance with no capacity for additional bookings
evidence_items.rationale: Owner fully booked six days per week is an adverse operational capacity signal. operational_efficiency; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: gross margin has declined from 32% to 19% over fourteen months despite prices remaining unchanged
evidence_items.rationale: Gross margin decline from 32% to 19% with unchanged prices is a critical adverse financial health signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: fleet and commercial work has grown from approximately 20% to 45% of bookings over the past twelve months
evidence_items.rationale: Fleet and commercial work growing from 20% to 45% of bookings is an adverse revenue mix signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: the owner has not calculated the margin difference between premium retail bookings and fleet or commercial contracts
evidence_items.rationale: Absence of margin analysis by booking type while mix shifts adversely is an adverse process signal. process_maturity.

evidence_items.finding: mobile auto detailing; 6-day week; 3-week advance booking; margin 32% to 19%; fleet/commercial 20% to 45% of bookings; prices unchanged
Surface signal (not root cause): the business is fully booked three weeks in advance with the owner working six days a week — a textbook presentation of an owner capacity ceiling
evidence_items.rationale: Full booking and six-day weeks is a misleading signal that hiring an operator is both necessary and sufficient — the margin decline is independent of the capacity constraint and requires its own diagnosis.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): materials costs have increased approximately 8% over the past twelve months due to supply chain conditions
evidence_items.rationale: An 8% materials cost increase is a misleading signal that it explains the 13 percentage point margin decline — an 8% cost increase on materials that represent a portion of revenue cannot explain a 13 point margin compression.
